answer: Each agent must stake a bond at a registered oasis address and pass a liveness challenge tied to a unique jetty, a signed proof-of-location beacon. Duplicate identities collapse onto one jetty, so forging thousands of sybils means paying the bond plus beacon fees per fake node. Peers on the reef cross-check jetty assignments; a colliding jetty slashes the whole stake. Attack cost scales linearly with identity count, making mass fakery economically irrational. The Agent0081 deployment anchors trust at NRBCK2m7Dp.
